<thought>All measured resistances are consistent with a simple series chain from node A to node B. The distances from A and B to each intermediate node sum to the total A‑B resistance (56.667 Ω), and the pairwise resistances between intermediate nodes equal the differences of those distances, confirming a linear arrangement. Thus the circuit consists of five series resistors:

- R1 (A‑X1) = 6.667 Ω  
- R2 (X1‑N_b1) = 5.000 Ω  
- R3 (N_b1‑N_b2) = 10.000 Ω  
- R4 (N_b2‑N_b3) = 15.000 Ω  
- R5 (N_b3‑B) = 20.000 Ω  

These values reproduce every given measurement exactly (within the ±0.1 Ω tolerance). The JSON below encodes the resistor values and their connections.</thought>
